projects.title: X-Ray Classification System
projects.description: Classifies X-ray images into pneumonia and normal categories using CNN. Built with TensorFlow/Keras on 5,000+ images, achieving 78% accuracy with 82% precision and 75% recall.

projects.title: Email Spam Classifier
projects.description: Detects and classifies emails as spam or non-spam using ML and NLP. Implemented TF-IDF vectorization and Naive Bayes, achieving 96% accuracy (95% precision, 97% recall). Applied lemmatisation and bi-gram feature engineering to push F1-score from 89% to 96%. Deployed on Hugging Face with 10ms average inference.

projects.title: Virtual Room Enhancer
projects.description: Improves room visuals and layout suggestions using generative AI. Enhanced AI-based room layouts with Google Gemini Studio, processing 100+ configurations with 95% real-time preview satisfaction.

projects.title: E-Commerce Sales Dashboard
projects.description: Interactive Power BI dashboard analyzing e-commerce sales across multiple countries — 11M quantity, 6K customers, 37K orders, 18M revenue. Features YoY revenue comparison, geographic distribution maps, and country performance breakdowns. UK dominates with 83% of total revenue.

projects.title: Facebook Ads Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: Power BI dashboard for Facebook ad campaign analysis — profit by gender, CTR by age group, conversion rate tracking, and ROI analysis. Includes revenue vs spend vs profit comparisons, scatter plot trends, and interactive campaign filters for data-driven marketing decisions.

projects.title: Student Feedback NLP Analyzer
projects.description: NLP-powered student feedback analysis system — sentiment classification, satisfaction scoring, and department performance dashboards. Processes 1,000+ survey responses using NLTK and TextBlob, achieving 94% accuracy. Produces interactive visualizations (word clouds, heat maps, trend charts) cutting review time by 75%.

projects.title: KrishiSevak — AI Agricultural Platform
projects.description: Led a 6-member team to architect an AI precision farming platform on GCP. Trained ensemble models (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, Neural Networks) on structured crop and soil datasets, improving yield prediction accuracy by 10% over baseline across 500+ crop-region combinations. Integrated Google Earth Engine satellite imagery with live weather and soil APIs.
